name: app-teardown
description: Idea-to-Build mobile app & game studio: tech stack advisor, mechanic-based top-5 App Store & Google Play teardown, YouTube gameplay frame-by-frame dissection, HEX color palettes, real-world subject & famous brand visual reference photo research, free UI/UX + 3D/2D model + SFX kits, and build-ready design blueprints.

suggestedPrompts: I want to build a hypercasual cooking gate-runner game where you pass through gates to build burgers.
